reproduction_conditions: Evaluating false assertions on curriculum concepts absent from the 138-pair table
empirical_evidence: Refutation recall drops from 78.00% on covered concepts to 10.00% on uncovered concepts (EXP-0026-CONCEPT-GENERALIZATION.json). In Phase N ablation A1, accuracy fell from 89.25% to 62.25% and refutation recall collapsed to 9.00%.
root_cause: Premise verification relies on exact hardcoded dictionary antonym pairs rather than generalized semantic contradiction reasoning.
mitigation_recommendation: Transition from static dictionary lookup to cross-encoder NLI or embedding-based contradiction scoring.

reproduction_conditions: Legitimate student questions querying relations between contrasting concepts (e.g. Flexbox row vs column, or border-box vs content-box)
empirical_evidence: Phase G error attribution shows 35 out of 120 holdout errors (29.2%) were VERIFIER_FALSE_REFUTATION, where valid questions were erroneously refuted.
root_cause: Word-boundary antonym check fires when query mentions one term and evidence contains opposite, failing to assess whether query asserted or questioned the state.
mitigation_recommendation: Enforce dependency-parsed assertion isolation and verify claim polarity before triggering refutations.

reproduction_conditions: Submitting out-of-curriculum queries on technologies absent from the 15-entity regex (e.g. Kubernetes, GraphQL, Svelte)
empirical_evidence: Stage 1 hardcodes 15 specific technology names (sidekiq, ruby, redis, flutter, etc.) matching exact benchmark entities. Without this regex, similarity threshold < 0.28 still caught 98% naturally in ablation A3.
root_cause: Benchmark-specific entity blacklist was manually coded to guarantee 100% unknown recall on known evaluation datasets.
mitigation_recommendation: Deprecate manual technology blacklist and rely strictly on calibrated cosine similarity threshold (< 0.28).

reproduction_conditions: Re-evaluating historical 2,000-case EXP-0023 benchmark suite under frozen EXP-0025 code
empirical_evidence: EXP-0026 Historical Regression (EXP-0026-HISTORICAL-REGRESSION.json): Overall accuracy dropped to 60.75%, FAR was 27.17% (failed <=15% gate), Refutation Recall was 37.00% (failed >=80% gate), and FRR was 20.00% (failed <=5% gate).
root_cause: EXP-0025 was hyper-fitted to the EXP-0025 dev/holdout distribution; its rules do not generalize to the broader historical query distribution.
mitigation_recommendation: Condition certification: freeze EXP-0025 strictly as a curriculum-scoped experimental baseline, and reject promotion to production.

reproduction_conditions: Compound queries using non-standard discourse markers (e.g. seeing as, notwithstanding that, semicolons)
empirical_evidence: Phase I cross-rule evaluation shows reduced clause decomposition accuracy when user input deviates from 3 hardcoded regex patterns.
root_cause: Regex-based clause splitting cannot parse arbitrary syntactic discourse trees in student natural language.
mitigation_recommendation: Utilize query condensation or LLM-based clause segmentation to separate presuppositions from questions.
